candidates.title: Low-vision physical orientation
candidates.decision: Choose individualized bedside orientation that lets an alert client with severe visual impairment locate and use needed objects independently after a change in room or meal setup.
candidates.format: Choose after the decision is fixed; use the smallest supported format that expresses it faithfully.

nearestExisting.whyThisDoesNotCloseCandidate: Directly covers accessible preparation instructions (audio/large print, ask preference, teach-back); it does not test locating objects or preserving independent everyday physical function in the room.
